Every point in these views is a ", "single-residue variant scored for its effect on receptor function and ", "surface expression across a panel of opioid ligands."), h3("What the data are"), tags$ul( tags$li(strong("Functional effect"), " — per-ligand change in signaling ", "for each variant, measured by a FACS-based reporter of receptor activation."), tags$li(strong("Surface expression"), " — effect of each variant on the amount ", "of receptor at the cell surface."), tags$li(strong("Dose-response"), " — for DAMGO, morphine and fentanyl we scored ", "each variant at every concentration of a full dose-response curve; the ", "per-concentration scores are selectable, alongside fitted EC50 and Emax."), tags$li(strong("Annotations"), " — GPCRdb generic numbers and secondary-structure ", "regions, AlphaMissense, missense-tolerance ratio (MTR), cross-species ", "ortholog conservation, and Boltz2 docking affinities.") ), h3("The four views"), tags$ul( tags$li(strong("Heatmap"), " — position x substitution grid for any score."), tags$li(strong("Scatter"), " — any score against any other, per variant or per position."), tags$li(strong("Snakeplot"), " — residues on the GPCRdb OPRM1 diagram, coloured by ", "score; click residues to select them (shared with the table)."), tags$li(strong("Data table"), " — the full variant table, sortable, filterable, downloadable.") ), h3("Notes & caveats"), p("Scores are model-derived estimates with associated uncertainty; see the paper ", "for full experimental and analytical methods. ============================================================================ # SERVER # ============================================================================ server <- function(input, output, session) { selected_pos <- reactiveVal(integer(0)) palette_for <- function(col, center) { if (center && is_diverging_score(col)) PAL_DIVERGING else PAL_SEQUENTIAL } observeEvent(input$hm_region_clear, updateSelectizeInput(session, "hm_region", selected = character(0))) observeEvent(input$sc_region_clear, updateSelectizeInput(session, "sc_region", selected = character(0))) # ------------------------------------------------------------- HEATMAP ----- output$hm_title <- renderText({ sprintf("%s", col_to_label[input$hm_score]) }) output$heatmap <- renderPlotly({ col <- input$hm_score rng <- input$hm_range sub <- variants[type == "missense" & mutation %in% aa_order & position >= rng[1] & position <= rng[2]] if (length(input$hm_region)) sub <- sub[SSE %in% input$hm_region] validate(need(nrow(sub) > 0, "No variants in the current selection.")) posv <- sort(unique(sub$position)) posc <- as.character(posv) z <- matrix(NA_real_, length(aa_order), length(posv), dimnames = list(aa_order, posc)) txt <- matrix(NA_character_, length(aa_order), length(posv), dimnames = list(aa_order, posc)) ri <- match(sub$mutation, aa_order) ci <- match(as.character(sub$position), posc) z[cbind(ri, ci)] <- sub[[col]] txt[cbind(ri, ci)] <- sprintf("%s%d%s
%s: %.3g", sub$wildtype, sub$position, sub$mutation, col_to_label[col], sub[[col]]) # wild-type residue per position, in the order of the x categories wt_by_pos <- unique(sub[, .(position, wt_aa)])[match(posv, position)] wt_lab <- ifelse(is.na(wt_by_pos$wt_aa), "", wt_by_pos$wt_aa) # Label only every 5th position (plus the ends) so the axis stays legible; # the full identity is always in the hover text. Ticks carry the wild-type # residue, e.g. "D147". n <- length(posv) keep <- which(posv %% 5 == 0) if (length(keep) < 2) { keep <- seq_len(n) # very narrow range: label them all } else { ends <- c(1L, n) keep <- sort(unique(c(keep, ends[vapply(ends, function(i) min(abs(keep - i)) >= 3, logical(1))]))) } tickvals <- posc[keep] ticktext <- paste0(wt_lab[keep], posv[keep]) center <- isTRUE(input$hm_center) && is_diverging_score(col) pal <- palette_for(col, isTRUE(input$hm_center)) dom <- range(z, na.rm = TRUE) if (!all(is.finite(dom))) dom <- c(-1, 1) if (center) { M <- max(abs(dom)); dom <- c(-M, M) } width_px <- max(760, 15 * length(posv) + 120) p <- plot_ly( width = width_px, x = posc, y = aa_order, z = z, text = txt, hoverinfo = "text", type = "heatmap", colors = NULL, colorscale = plotly_colorscale(pal), zmin = dom[1], zmax = dom[2], xgap = 0.3, ygap = 0.3, colorbar = list(title = list(text = col_to_label[col], font = list(size = 11)), thickness = 12, len = 0.9) ) # transparent markers over the empty squares: keeps hover (and therefore the # position readout) working everywhere on the grid, not just where we have data na_idx <- which(is.na(z), arr.ind = TRUE) if (nrow(na_idx)) { p <- add_trace( p, x = posc[na_idx[, 2]], y = aa_order[na_idx[, 1]], type = "scatter", mode = "markers", inherit = FALSE, marker = list(size = 12, color = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"), hoverinfo = "text", showlegend = FALSE, text = local({ w <- wt_lab[na_idx[, 2]]; pp <- posv[na_idx[, 2]] m <- aa_order[na_idx[, 1]] ifelse(w == m, sprintf("%s%d
wild type", w, pp), sprintf("%s%d%s
no data", w, pp, m)) })) } if (isTRUE(input$hm_wt)) { wt <- unique(sub[, .(position, wt_aa)]) wt <- wt[wt_aa %in% aa_order] p <- add_trace(p, x = as.character(wt$position), y = wt$wt_aa, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", inherit = FALSE, marker = list(symbol = "x", size = 4, color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)"), hoverinfo = "text", text = paste0("wt ", wt$wt_aa, wt$position), showlegend = FALSE) } p %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = "Residue position", type = "category", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = posc, tickmode = "array", tickvals = tickvals, ticktext = ticktext, tickangle = -90, tickfont = list(size = 9), showspikes = TRUE, spikemode = "across", spikethickness = 1, spikedash = "dot", spikecolor = "#888888"), yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(aa_order), tickfont = list(size = 11)), hovermode = "closest", margin = list(l = 30, r = 10, t = 10, b = 55) ) %>% config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = "position") { d <- copy(positions) xk <- paste0(xcol, "__mean"); yk <- paste0(ycol, "__mean") validate(need(xk %in% names(d) && yk %in% names(d), "Score unavailable at position level.")) d[, `:=`(x = get(xk), y = get(yk))] d[, label := sprintf("%s%d (%s)", wt_aa, position, SSE)] ck <- NULL if (!is.null(input$sc_color) && input$sc_color != "") { if (input$sc_color %in% names(d)) ck <- else NA] } else { d <- copy(variants) d[, `:=`(x = get(xcol), y = get(ycol))] d[, label := sprintf("%s (%s)", hgvs, SSE)] d[, cval := if (!is.null(input$sc_color) && input$sc_color != "" && r, NA), nrow(d)) }) output$scatter <- renderPlotly({ d <- scatter_data() validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No points to plot.")) color_is_num <- input$sc_color != "" && is.numeric(d$cval) && any(is.finite(d$cval)) color_is_cat <- input$sc_color != "" && !color_is_num p <- plot_ly(d, x = ~x, y = ~y, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~label, hoverinfo = "text", marker = list(size = "text", color = ~cval, colors = PAL_SEQUENTIAL, marker = list(size = if (input$sc_level == "position") 7 else 4, opacity = 0.75, line = list(width = 0))) } else if (color_is_cat) { p <- plot_ly(d, x = ~x, y = ~y, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~label, hoverinfo = "text", color = ~as.character(cval), colors = PAL_QUAL, marker = list(size = if (input$sc_level == "position") 7 else 4, opacity = 0.75, line = list(width = 0))) } if (color_is_num) { lab <- col_to_label[input$sc_color] p <- plotly::colorbar(p, title = if (is.na(lab)) input$sc_color else unname(lab)) } if (isTRUE(input$sc_line)) { lim <- range(c(d$x, d$y), na.rm = TRUE) p <- add_trace(p, x = lim, y = lim, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", inherit = FALSE, line = list(dash = "dot", color = "grey"), hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) } p %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = col_to_label[input$sc_x], zeroline = TRUE), yaxis = list(title = col_to_label[input$sc_y], zeroline = TRUE), legend = list(title = list(text = input$sc_color), font = list(size = 10)) ) %>% config(displaylogo = FALSE) }) # ------------------------------------------------------------ SNAKEPLOT ---- snake_vals <- reactive({ col <- paste0(input$snk_score, "__", input$snk_agg) validate(need(col %in% names(positions), "Score not available.")) positions[, .(position, val = get(col))] }) observe({ dv <- snake_vals() pal <- palette_for(input$snk_score, isTRUE(input$snk_center)) center <- if (isTRUE(input$snk_center) && is_diverging_score(input$snk_score)) 0 else NULL hex <- values_to_hex(dv$val, pal, center = center) ok <- is.finite(dv$val) session$sendCustomMessage("snake_recolor", list( ids = as.integer(dv$position[ok]), colors = as.character(hex[ok]), values = as.character(signif(dv$val[ok], 3)), score_label = sprintf("%s (%s)", unname(col_to_label[input$snk_score]), input$snk_agg), default_color = NA_COLOR )) }) output$snk_legend <- renderUI({ dv <- snake_vals() pal <- palette_for(input$snk_score, isTRUE(input$snk_center)) center <- if (isTRUE(input$snk_center) && is_diverging_score(input$snk_score)) 0 else NULL dom <- range(dv$val, na.rm = TRUE) if (!all(is.finite(dom))) dom <- c(0, 1) if (!is.null(center)) { M <- max(abs(dom)); dom <- c(-M, M) } grad <- sprintf("linear-gradient(to right, %s)", paste(pal, collapse = ", ")) tagList( div(class = "small-muted", style = "margin-top:6px;", "Colour scale"), div(class = "legend-bar", style = sprintf("background:%s;", grad)), div(style = "display:flex; justify-content:space-between;", span(class = "small-muted", sprintf("%.2g", dom[1])), span(class = "small-muted", sprintf("%.2g", mean(dom))), span(class = "small-muted", sprintf("%.2g", dom[2]))) ) }) # click toggles selection observeEvent(input$snake_click, { id <- as.integer(input$snake_click$id) cur <- selected_pos() selected_pos(if (id %in% cur) setdiff(cur, id) else sort(c(cur, id))) }) observeEvent(input$snk_clear, selected_pos(integer(0))) # push highlight to the SVG observe({ session$sendCustomMessage("snake_highlight", list(ids = as.integer(selected_pos()), color = "#ff2d55")) }) output$snk_selection <- renderUI({ sp <- selected_pos() if (!length(sp)) return(div(class = "small-muted", "None selected.")) meta <- positions[position %in% sp] lab <- sprintf("%s%d", meta$wt_aa, meta$position) tagList( div(sprintf("%d residue%s:", length(sp), ifelse(length(sp) == 1, "", "s"))), div(lapply(lab, function(x) span(class = "sel-chip", x))) ) }) # ------------------------------------------------------------- TABLE ------- table_data <- reactive({ d <- variants if (isTRUE(input$tbl_missense)) d <- d[type == "missense"] if duplicated column. if ("wt_aa" %in% names(d)) d <- d[, setdiff(names(d), "wt_aa"), with = FALSE] d }) output$table <- renderDT({ d <- table_data() num_cols <- names(d)[vapply(d, is.numeric, wildtype][1] if (dr_mode() == "variant") sprintf("%s%d%s - dose-response", wt, pos, input$dr_mut) else { lig <- if (length(input$dr_ligs)) input$dr_ligs[1] else dr_ligands[1] sprintf("Position %d (%s) # global.R — loaded once per R process, shared by ui.R/server.R (app.R).
suppressMessages({
  library(shiny)
  library(bslib)
  library(data.table)
  library(plotly)
  library(DT)
})

DATA_DIR <- "data"
variants  <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "variants.rds"))
positions <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "positions.rds"))
META      <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "meta.rds"))

setDT(variants); setDT(positions)

# dose-response data (raw per-dose points + up-to-date robust 3-param fits)
dr_points <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "dr_points.rds")); setDT(dr_points)
dr_fits   <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "dr_fits.rds"));   setDT(dr_fits)
setkey(dr_points, position, mutation, ligand)
setkey(dr_fits,   position, mutation, ligand)
dr_ligands <- META$dr_ligands
dr_syn     <- as.data.table(META$dr_syn)
dr_conc    <- as.data.table(META$dr_conc)
# per-ligand activity scale (synonymous Emin -> 0, Emax -> 1); NULL on older
# data bundles, in which case the app just stays on the raw score axis.
dr_act     <- if (!is.null(META$dr_act)) as.data.table(META$dr_act) else NULL
# synonymous 95% envelope (2.5-97.5 pct across reference fits), per ligand
dr_band    <- if (!is.null(META$dr_band)) as.data.table(META$dr_band) else NULL
# 3-param Hill (slope fixed = 1), x = log10[M] — matches curve_refitting fits
hill3 <- function(x, emin, emax, ec50) emin + (emax - emin) / (1 + 10^(ec50 - x))
DR_LIG_COLORS <- c(Morphine = "#2166ac", Fentanyl = "#b2182b", DAMGO = "#1b7837")
molar_fmt <- function(logM) {
  if (!is.finite(logM)) return(NA_character_)
  m <- 10^logM
  if (m < 1e-9) sprintf("%.2g pM", m * 1e12)
  else if (m < 1e-6) sprintf("%.2g nM", m * 1e9)
  else sprintf("%.2g uM", m * 1e6)
}

score_cols  <- META$score_cols          # named vector: label -> column
score_group <- META$score_group         # named vector: label -> group
cat_cols    <- META$cat_cols
aa_order    <- META$aa_order
sse_levels  <- META$sse_levels
agg_funcs   <- META$agg_funcs

# ---- grouped choices for the score selectInputs ----------------------------
score_choices <- local({
  labs <- names(score_cols)
  grps <- unique(score_group[labs])
  out <- lapply(grps, function(g) {
    l <- labs[score_group[labs] == g]
    setNames(unname(score_cols[l]), l)          # value = column, display = label
  })
  setNames(out, grps)
})
col_to_label <- setNames(names(score_cols), unname(score_cols))

# region -> position ranges (for quick-jump on the heatmap) ------------------
region_pos <- variants[SSE %in% sse_levels,
                       .(lo = min(position), hi = max(position)), by = SSE]
setkey(region_pos, SSE)

# ---- colour palettes -------------------------------------------------------
PAL_DIVERGING <- c("#2166ac", "#4393c3", "#92c5de", "#d1e5f0", "#f7f7f7",
                   "#fddbc7", "#f4a582", "#d6604d", "#b2182b")
PAL_SEQUENTIAL <- c("#440154", "#443983", "#31688e", "#21918c",
                    "#35b779", "#90d743", "#fde725")
NA_COLOR <- "#e8e8e8"
# 16-colour qualitative palette (d3 category20-style) for categorical colouring
# such as the 16 SSE regions — avoids plotly's Set2 8-colour ceiling.
PAL_QUAL <- c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", "#8c564b",
              "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#aec7e8", "#ffbb78",
              "#98df8a", "#ff9896", "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94")

# heuristic: does a score straddle zero (=> diverging, centred) ?
is_diverging_score <- function(col) {
  v <- variants[[col]]
  if (is.null(v)) return(FALSE)
  mn <- suppressWarnings(min(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  mx <- suppressWarnings(max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  is.finite(mn) && is.finite(mx) && mn < -1e-6 && mx > 1e-6
}

# map numeric values -> hex, given palette + domain (+ optional symmetric centre)
values_to_hex <- function(vals, pal, domain = NULL, center = NULL) {
  if (is.null(domain)) domain <- range(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(center)) {
    m <- max(abs(domain - center), na.rm = TRUE)
    domain <- c(center - m, center + m)
  }
  if (!all(is.finite(domain)) || diff(domain) == 0) domain <- c(-1, 1)
  ramp <- grDevices::colorRamp(pal)
  t <- (vals - domain[1]) / (domain[2] - domain[1])
  t[t < 0] <- 0; t[t > 1] <- 1
  out <- rep(NA_COLOR, length(vals))
  ok <- is.finite(t)
  if (any(ok)) {
    rgb <- ramp(t[ok])
    out[ok] <- grDevices::rgb(rgb[, 1], rgb[, 2], rgb[, 3], maxColorValue = 255)
  }
  attr(out, "domain") <- domain
  out
}

# plotly colorscale (list of [t, color]) from a palette vector
plotly_colorscale <- function(pal) {
  n <- length(pal)
  lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) list((i - 1) / (n - 1), pal[i]))
}

APP_VERSION <- "1.1"

# --- shinylive bundling shim -------------------------------------------------
# When exporting to a static (shinylive/webR) site, shinylive omits these
# transitive dependencies of plotly -> ggplot2/scales: it assumes they live in
# webR's base image, but the base image only ships ~33 packages and none of
# these. Loading ggplot2's namespace then fails and the app never starts.
# A static reference here makes shinylive's scanner bundle their WebAssembly
# builds. This block never runs, so it has no effect on the server build.
if (FALSE) {
  requireNamespace("munsell");    requireNamespace("colorspace")
  requireNamespace("MASS");       requireNamespace("mgcv")
  requireNamespace("Matrix");     requireNamespace("lattice")
  requireNamespace("nlme");       requireNamespace("fansi")
}
